data_protocol.fit: all train components not connected to any valid row group
data_protocol.evaluation: all valid row groups; fixed FINAL5 only

primary_contrast: same-seed KD GRU minus labels-only GRU
teacher_role: fresh compact Transformer trained on the same source holdout per seed
objective: (label_WMSE + kd_weight * teacher_WMSE) / (1 + kd_weight); label-derived weights and all_after_warmup mask; no hints
precision: bf16_bf16x9; FP32 masters, gradients, state and loss

batch_candidates.teacher_origin: PR43 compact fit transfer candidate only

retention: final_only: safe epoch-boundary training_state.pt overwritten atomically and one final model.pt per cell

resource_policy.host_resume_staging: sum profile rank RSS plus 12*parameters*world_size; <=80% of actual job RAM
resource_policy.scratch: 32*parameters plus canonical FP32 prediction/cache arrays plus10GiB, checked against free scratch

order: accept receiver correctness checks; all must pass without skips

quality_gate.meaning: screen for follow-up only; two seeds do not establish statistical significance

verification_regime: Exposed development evidence; receiver correctness and profiles pending, no public transfer evidence
